performance_case.causal_mechanism: A completed sequence of returns may encode the stability, concentration or temporal shape of recent price discovery rather than only cumulative sign; only one fixed predecision state with incremental information beyond momentum, reversal, volatility, sign persistence, path efficiency and autocorrelation could justify a later matched-capital screen.
performance_case.claim_boundary: This task may use only four frozen access-proven public primary manuscripts, verify only the identity and frozen coverage of the sealed pre-2025 Binance H1 corpus, and use the public OKX complete-candle route only as schema and prospective availability proof. It may return one deterministic low-complexity return-trajectory preregistration skeleton or close the family. FPCA, deep learning, Boruta, technical-rule search and other fitted or outcome-selected methods are non-transferable. Binance-to-OKX venue equivalence remains MISSING_PROOF. It cannot read factor or strategy outcomes, retain market values, train or fit a model, compute PnL or drawdown, register a hypothesis or candidate, run a strategy, open OOS, modify the active forward contract, deploy or activate Trading.
performance_case.drawdown_hypothesis: Only a later matched-capital experiment could test whether a predecision trajectory state avoids unstable downside paths without sacrificing broad upside participation. This literature-only task has zero immediate drawdown effect and all magnitude claims remain MISSING_PROOF.
performance_case.opportunity_cost: A bounded four-source screen can reject fitted-model and technical-rule narratives before runner work, while the one-idea cap and closed-family dedup prevent another price-only variant from displacing the active forward evidence lane.
performance_case.performance_hypothesis: If one fixed low-complexity return trajectory has incremental predecision information and later survives equal-capital fees, adverse slippage, large-move stability, annual breadth and drawdown gates, it may improve fee-adjusted total PnL versus an unchanged BTC parent. The present task makes no alpha or performance claim.
